_comment: Per-seat copy for /seat/VIC/<District>. Every district works without an entry: the hook falls back to default_hook_labor or default_hook_other. Add an entry to give a seat its own hook, a quote per candidate (stances, keyed by exact candidate name, from the survey), or after the ballot draw the ballot order (ballot: [{name, party}]), which switches the seat to the printable scorecard.
default_hook_labor: Held by Labor, the party that put the fire tax on every rates notice in Victoria and is campaigning to keep it.
default_hook_other: The fire tax is on every rates notice in this seat. 28 November is the chance to scrap it.
